scripts.build: npm run build:plan && npm run build:map && npm run build:serve
scripts.build:plan: vite build --mode plan && mkdir -p ../assets/client && cp dist/plan.js ../assets/client/plan.js && cp dist/plan.css ../assets/client/plan-components.css
scripts.build:map: vite build --mode map && mkdir -p ../assets/client && cp dist/map.js ../assets/client/map.js && cp dist/map.css ../assets/client/map.css
scripts.build:serve: vite build --mode serve && mkdir -p ../assets/client && cp dist/serve.js ../assets/client/serve.js && cp dist/serve.css ../assets/client/serve.css
